summary_en: 200,000 shares (5.0% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,250/share (day's close). Upper limit ¥250M. Single execution window 2026-08-05, 8:45 JST, settlement same day. No partial execution if orders insufficient.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-04 the board of Hokuetsu Metal resolved to acquire its own shares under Article 459(1) of the Companies Act. The company will place a buy order via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 2026-08-05 at 8:45 JST at ¥1,250 per share (the previous day's closing price including final special quotation). The upper limit is 200,000 shares (5.0% of shares outstanding, calculated against 3,993,806 shares outstanding ex-treasury as of 2026-07-31) and ¥250M in aggregate. The buy order will be matched against sell orders during the single trading window; if insufficient sell orders are received, the entire block may not execute. Results will be announced after trading closes. The stated rationale is to enhance corporate value and shareholder returns, respond to changing business conditions, and maintain flexibility for future capital strategy.
